references.text: Parallel account in Judges where Othniel, son of Kenaz, captures Kiriath-Sepher and takes Achsah as his wife
Othniel, son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, becomes Israel's first judge and delivers the people from oppression
Caleb, son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, is mentioned as a faithful man who followed the Lord wholeheartedly
The background story of Caleb and his inheritance, which explains the context for Othniel's conquest
Othniel is mentioned in Caleb's genealogy as the son of Kenaz
Previous verses where Caleb promises to give his daughter Achsah to whoever captures Kiriath-Sepher
